# TideLine Strategies

> Business operations consulting, workflow automation and custom software for owner-led service businesses.

- [TideLine](https://tidelinestrats.com/): Services, team and contact information.
- [WonPlace](https://wonplace.tidelinestrats.com/): Class operations software for gymnastics gyms.

Loki is an interactive business operations assistant. Its private conversations and app are not public reference material.
